manifest.fixture_model: Deep-copy base_lifecycle and base_verification_context, then apply each vector's add, remove, and replace operations in listed order using JSON Pointer paths. The lifecycle copy is a structural fixture envelope.
manifest.fixture_output_boundary: The evaluations and overall_result stored in base_lifecycle are structural fixture placeholders. They are not scenario inputs and MUST NOT be represented as verifier-produced results for a materialized vector.
manifest.scenario_input_projection: After applying semantic_changes, remove evaluations and overall_result. Emit the remaining lifecycle as scenario-input; emit base_verification_context separately. No expected values are verifier inputs.
manifest.integrity_recomputation: When recompute_integrity is true, recompute affected record payload digests under the declared canonicalization and digest algorithm, update dependent record references and typed-link endpoints transitively, and regenerate or remove invalidated integrity assertions. When false, preserve the deliberate inconsistency.
manifest.evaluation_model: Eligible semantic cases supply separate scenario-input and verification-context artifacts. A future verifier independently computes actual outputs; expected-output is only a comparator oracle. Structural negative cases have no semantic oracle. The current harness performs structural and oracle-consistency checks only.
manifest.digest_values: Synthetic identifiers for semantic testing; they are not hashes of the fixture bytes.
manifest.claim_boundary: These are machine-readable scenario skeletons, not cryptographic known-answer vectors and not evidence of an implementation run.
manifest.verification_context_boundary: Synthetic resolver/test-double declarations, not live anchoring evidence or actual GALC verifier results. A future test driver must instantiate this context explicitly and bind its immutable revision to the run. It must not read expected-output while evaluating a scenario.

data.independence_basis: Separately administered observer with distinct signing key and data path.
limitations: Physical observation remains subject to sensor and oracle uncertainty.

data.residual_grounding_uncertainty: Record integrity and cross-record correlation do not prove that the physical observer reported reality truthfully.

vectors.title: Authorized and matched transition
vectors.forbidden_inference: A correlated lifecycle must not be represented as proof that the physical observation is objectively true.

vectors.title: Valid components bound to the wrong determination
vectors.forbidden_inference: Valid signatures on each component do not establish that the enforcement event consumed the governed determination.

vectors.title: Determination expired before enforcement
vectors.forbidden_inference: Signature validity must not override expiry.

vectors.title: Authority revoked before irreversible boundary
vectors.forbidden_inference: A previously valid determination must not survive a revocation condition it declares invalidating.

vectors.title: Execution parameter substitution
vectors.forbidden_inference: Successful operation completion does not establish that authorized parameters were used.

vectors.title: Consumed authorization replay
vectors.forbidden_inference: An idempotency key is not evidence of single execution unless consumption state is checked.

vectors.title: Partial execution
vectors.forbidden_inference: Command acceptance must not be reported as completed execution.

vectors.title: Missing resulting-state observation
vectors.forbidden_inference: A completed execution report must not be represented as a verified external consequence.

vectors.title: Conflicting resulting-state observers

data.independence_basis: Separately administered observer with distinct signing key and data path.
limitations: Synthetic conflicting observation; no external truth claim is made.

vectors.forbidden_inference: A majority or higher confidence score must not silently erase a materially conflicting observation.

vectors.title: Observed consequence differs from governed transition
vectors.forbidden_inference: Internal execution success must not override contradictory resulting-state evidence.

vectors.title: Anchored evidence with insufficient custody evidence

value: The referenced custody result cannot presently establish complete continuity.

vectors.forbidden_inference: Anchoring must not imply a complete handling history.

vectors.title: Complete custody with unavailable anchoring
vectors.forbidden_inference: Custody must not imply independently established time.

vectors.title: Valid records with corrupted lifecycle-link digest
vectors.forbidden_inference: Integrity of endpoint records must not validate a corrupted relationship between them.

vectors.title: Correlated records with unresolved external grounding
vectors.forbidden_inference: Cryptographic integrity and lifecycle correlation must not be represented as proof of external truth.

vectors.title: Sender-side offer without counterparty acceptance
vectors.forbidden_inference: Sender-side creation or transmission of an offer must not be represented as counterparty acceptance.

vectors.title: Accepted custody evidence later unavailable

value: The previously accepted artifact is no longer retrievable.

vectors.forbidden_inference: Prior acceptance must not be rewritten as current availability or as never having been accepted.

vectors.title: Accepted custody claim without result reference
vectors.forbidden_inference: A producer-supplied accepted status must not establish custody continuity without a checkable result identity.

vectors.title: Duplicate evaluation of one property
vectors.forbidden_inference: A verifier must not select a preferred duplicate result or report the evaluation set as correlated.

vectors.title: Anchored claim without a reference
vectors.forbidden_inference: An anchored label without a locator and immutable result reference is structurally invalid; it has no semantic oracle.

vectors.title: Anchoring result cannot be retrieved
vectors.forbidden_inference: A locator and immutable result reference do not establish retrieval or verification. Unavailable anchoring evidence must not become pass.

vectors.title: Inclusion verifies but time is operator asserted
vectors.forbidden_inference: Inclusion alone does not authenticate time. Operator-asserted time must not become temporal_anchoring pass.

vectors.title: Referenced anchoring result fails integrity verification
vectors.forbidden_inference: A retrieved result with failed integrity is not valid anchoring evidence. Confirmed invalid evidence and unavailable evidence remain distinct.
